scope: Small stationary-ego pipeline pilot, not sufficient training diversity or full Phase 2 acceptance. Six spatially separated scene groups; RGB inputs isolated from simulator GT semantic/depth/3D/road labels. No model, inference, perception quality, long driving episode or real-world claim.
limitations: Stationary ego and 1.5 simulation seconds per scene
Only six groups in one shared town
NPC vehicles are one blueprint; no pedestrians/bicycles/motorcycles collected
Origin separation/group disjointness do not guarantee zero visual content overlap
3D boxes are GT and include occluded/out-of-view actors
No trained perception or model quality metric
